news.title: Temporary win for sector taking on Duration of Status in court
news.summary_en: New rules that limit international students to a defined duration of status while studying in the US will not begin on September 15.
news.author: Amy Baker

news.title: EC English closes all global schools
news.summary_en: EC English Language Centres has confirmed it is closing all its 25 language schools across seven destinations, effective immediately.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: One Nation pledges net-negative migration and 750,000 cut to temporary visas
news.summary_en: Australia’s opposition One Nation party has pledged to deliver net-negative migration during the first three years of a One Nation government, including a cut of more than 750,000 temporary visas.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Russell group predicted to be only mission group in the green as two-tier BCA system emerges
news.summary_en: While no formal two-tier system exists in UK higher education, predictive analysis from The PIE shows that the Russell Group may be the only mission group to achieve "green" levels of visa refusals according to the new Basic Compliance Assessment.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert and Dave Amor

news.title: “We can’t just wait it out”: experts tout partnerships as antidote to compliance squeeze
news.summary_en: International student policy shifts across the big four are not "a cycle we can simply wait out” and will force universities to rethink how they recruit, partner and design learning, sector leaders argued in a panel on international pathways and compliance.
news.author: Beth Kennedy
